action: If prerequisite gate fails, route to prerequisite concept before reteaching dependent concept.
If explanation/representation fails, provide alternate representation + worked contrast.
If application fails but concept is understood, use scaffolded steps and fading prompts.
If repeated tagged error occurs, deliver targeted misconception correction and contrastive example.
If transfer fails, vary surface features while preserving underlying structure.
If stability falls after spacing, schedule retrieval practice with increasing intervals.
